clips.send: Opium War and Treaty of Nanjing. 1840—1842. The beginning of China’s modern history. June 1839: the official Lin Zexu (林则徐 Lín Zéxú) destroyed confiscated opium on the beach at Humen (虎门 Hǔmén), near Guangzhou — a heavy blow to opium smuggling. June 1840: using the Humen opium destruction as an excuse, Britain launched the Opium War. August 1842: the Qing government was forced to sign the Treaty of Nanjing: cede Hong Kong Island to Britain; pay 21 million silver dollars; open Guangzhou, Xiamen, Fuzhou, Ningbo and Shanghai as treaty ports; tariffs on British goods had to be agreed with Britain. Impact: China began to sink into a semi-colonial, semi-feudal society. The Opium War marks the start of China’s modern history.

clips.send: Summary. Step by step, progressive Chinese learned from the West ever more deeply: technology, institutions, ideas. Each attempt failed to save China on its own — the search continued into 1919. Try the 3D staircase next!

clips.send: 1898, The Hundred Days’ Reform. Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao persuaded Emperor Guangxu to reform. After 103 days, Empress Dowager Cixi staged a coup — but the reform enlightened people’s minds. This was learning institutions.

clips.send: 1860s–1890s, The Self-Strengthening Movement. To “self-strengthen”, officials built arsenals (Anqing, Jiangnan, Fuzhou); to “seek wealth”, they built civilian companies, and created the Beiyang Fleet.

clips.send: 1900–1901, The Eight-Nation Alliance. Allied armies took Tianjin and Beijing. The Boxer Protocol demanded 450 million taels, a legation quarter and foreign troops — China completely became a semi-colonial, semi-feudal society.

clips.send: 1894–1895, The Sino-Japanese War. The Beiyang Fleet was destroyed. The Treaty of Shimonoseki ceded the Liaodong Peninsula, Taiwan and Penghu, cost 200 million taels and opened four more ports — greatly deepening China’s semi-colonial status.

clips.send: Hong Kong. Britain took Hong Kong after the Opium Wars. China resumed sovereignty in 1997 under “one country, two systems”.

clips.send: Guangzhou. Guangzhou has traded by sea since the Qin and Han. In the Tang and Song it was a starting point of the Maritime Silk Road.

clips.send: 1911–1912, The 1911 Revolution. On 10 October 1911 the Wuchang Uprising broke out. On 1 January 1912 Sun Yat-sen became Provisional President in Nanjing — the Republic of China was born and the monarchy ended.

clips.send: 1915, The New Culture Movement. Chen Duxiu founded Youth Magazine (later New Youth) in Shanghai; the movement centred on Peking University. Its banners: democracy and science. Learning now reached the level of ideas.

clips.send: 1851–1864, The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. Hong Xiuquan rose at Jintian, Guangxi (1851). The Taipings fought north and in 1853 made Nanjing their capital, Tianjing. Crushed by Chinese and foreign forces, it fell in 1864.

clips.send: 1856–1860, The Second Opium War. The Treaty of Tianjin opened ten more ports, deep up the Yangtze; the Convention of Peking added Tianjin and ceded Kowloon. Anglo-French troops burned the Old Summer Palace.

clips.send: Kowloon. Today: Kowloon, Hong Kong. The peninsula across the harbour from Hong Kong Island. Britain took its southern tip in 1860; China resumed sovereignty over all of Hong Kong in 1997.

clips.send: Nanjing. Nanjing has been a capital for many dynasties. In December 1937 Japanese troops murdered about 300,000 Chinese people here (the Nanjing Massacre). It was liberated on 23 April 1949.

clips.send: 香港。鸦片战争后，香港被英国占领。1997年中国恢复对香港行使主权，实行“一国两制”。

clips.send: 1900—1901年 · 八国联军侵华。联军攻占天津、北京。《辛丑条约》赔款白银4.5亿两，划定使馆界，允许外国驻兵——中国完全沦为半殖民地半封建社会。

clips.send: 1894—1895年 · 甲午中日战争。北洋舰队全军覆没。《马关条约》割辽东半岛、台湾及澎湖列岛，赔款白银2亿两，开放沙市、重庆、苏州、杭州——大大加深了中国半殖民地化程度。

clips.send: 九龙。今天：香港九龙。与香港岛隔海相望的半岛。1860年英国割占九龙司地方一区，1997年中国恢复对香港行使主权。

clips.send: 1911—1912年 · 辛亥革命。1911年10月10日武昌起义爆发。1912年1月1日，孙中山在南京就任临时大总统，中华民国成立，君主专制制度被推翻。

clips.send: 19世纪60—90年代 · 洋务运动。以“自强”为口号创办军事工业（安庆内军械所、江南制造总局、福州船政局）；以“求富”为口号创办民用工业，并建立北洋水师。

clips.send: 1842年 ·《南京条约》，中国近代史上第一个不平等条约：割香港岛，赔款2100万银元，开放广州、厦门、福州、宁波、上海五处通商口岸，协定关税。

clips.send: 南京。南京是多个朝代的都城。1937年12月，日军在这里屠杀我国同胞30万以上（南京大屠杀）。1949年4月23日南京解放。

clips.send: 虎门。1839年，林则徐在这里的海滩上销毁了一百多万千克鸦片。扼守珠江口的虎门炮台在鸦片战争中遭到英军进攻。

clips.send: 1840年 · 鸦片战争。1839年6月，林则徐主持虎门销烟。1840年，英国以此为借口发动鸦片战争——这是中国近代史的开端。

clips.send: 1856—1860年 · 第二次鸦片战争。《天津条约》增开10处通商口岸，深入长江沿岸；《北京条约》增开天津、割九龙司。英法联军火烧圆明园。

clips.send: 1851—1864年 · 太平天国运动。1851年洪秀全在广西金田起义，太平军一路北上，1853年定都南京，改名天京。在中外反动势力联合镇压下，1864年天京陷落。

clips.send: 小结。先进的中国人学习西方步步深入：器物，制度，思想。每一次探索都没能单独完成救国使命，探索仍在继续，直到1919年。接下来去3D阶梯里看看吧！
